item.title: Pakistan players 'more focused on earning money': Ex-chief selector claims
item.summary: Former Pakistan spinner Iqbal Qasim criticised young cricketers for prioritising money and league contracts over improving skills and game awareness. He also questioned selectors’ lack of vision and warned against interference in cricket administration. Recalling his playing days, Qasim highlighted the importance of independent preparation, discipline and representing Pakistan, saying financial rewards naturally follow improved performance.
